features.range: Right expands, left connects; native mouse, touch and keyboard input
features.callouts: Three progressive side explanations, each connected to a real projected plane pin. Tap a visible label to focus its plane.
features.reversal: Reveal amount, lines and layers retrace the range position; all ten scroll bridges remain reversible.
features.full_state: Finite sequential focus and light scan; no new idle loop.

recording: Published page, native pointer drag right, focus side labels, then drag left. Not a device performance benchmark.
accessibility: Native range, keyboard control, reduced-motion explicit interaction, static/no-JS guide, readable labels and pointer-transparent leaders.
compatibility_fix: Individually projected planes avoid a WebKit nested-translateZ compositing failure discovered during visual QA.
